partner.title: Partner registration link
partner.hint: Each bot has its own link. The registration button in this bot’s Mini App uses it.
partner.linkHint: https only. {click_id} becomes the user’s personal click code, {bot_id} the bot ID, {partner_id} the partner ID. An empty field turns registration off.
partner.partnerIdHint: Saved with every click and used for {partner_id}.
partner.saved: Link saved. New clicks use it right away; earlier clicks and user bindings are kept.
partner.cleared: Link removed. The Mini App will say that registration is not set up yet.

problem.format: This does not look like an https link.
problem.no_click_id: The link has no {click_id}: the partner cannot report which user registered.
problem.partner_id_empty: The link contains {partner_id}, but the partner ID is empty.
problem.private_host: The address points to a private network; it is not checked and will not work for users.
problem.click_id_not_in_final_url: click_id is not visible in the address at the last redirect step. Make a test registration and check that the postback arrives with your click_id.
problem.too_many_redirects: Too many redirects (more than 8): the chain was not checked to the end.
problem.bad_redirect: The site redirects to an invalid address.

partner.howItWorks: How it works: the user taps the registration button, the server creates a personal click_id and stores it with the Telegram ID, bot ID and partner ID, then opens your link. Once postback is connected, the partner sends that click_id back and the registration is confirmed automatically.
partner.chain: Redirect path (as the server sees it)
partner.chainHint: Parameter values other than the test click_id are hidden. If click_id is not visible at the last step, that is not an error yet: the partner tracker may keep it on its side. Only a test registration with an incoming postback proves that click_id is preserved.

telegram.title: Menu button and welcome
telegram.hint: Applied in Telegram as soon as you save. A step counts as done only after Telegram confirms it.
telegram.menuButtonHint: The button next to the message field opens the Mini App. Up to 32 characters.
telegram.welcomeNote: The bot replies in the language the user picked in the Mini App, otherwise in the bot’s default language. The message always has a button that opens the app.
telegram.partial: Saved, but Telegram rejected some steps. Reasons are below.

delete.title: Delete bot
delete.text: Removes this bot’s settings, users, demo signal history, clicks and postback events. Other bots are untouched. The webhook and menu button are removed in Telegram. The deletion stays in the audit log. This cannot be undone; to pause a bot, use Disable.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Languages and Mini App, Forex and OTC — separately for each bot.
settings.systemHint: Set by environment variables in Render. Secrets are never shown here.

postback.title: Postback and deposits
postback.subtitle: One postback for every bot: registrations, first and repeat deposits.
postback.legacyNote: A single-bot source from the previous version. It keeps working; use the shared source for new connections.
postback.createHint: Defaults match Pocket Partners: the {click_id}, {trader_id} and {sumdep} macros. The event type is a fixed value we put into each of the three postback URLs.
postback.optional: Optional. Leave empty if the partner does not send it.
postback.dedupNote: Pocket Partners sends no event ID. So registration and first deposit count once per Trader ID, and a re-delivery of the same repeat deposit (same amount within 10 minutes) counts once. The first deposit amount never changes once received.
postback.templatesHint: Paste these URLs in Pocket Partners → Postbacks, one for each event.
postback.secretPlaceholder: Replace SECRET with the secret shown at creation. If it is lost, issue a new one.

errCode.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: Possible repeat deposit (counted, check the history)
errCode.CLICK_OTHER_USER: Click ID belongs to another user
errCode.TRADER_AMBIGUOUS: Deposit: Trader ID found in several bots

diagnosis.matched_trader_id: Deposit matched by the linked Trader ID
diagnosis.registration_awaiting: Registration received, the user has not entered the Trader ID yet
diagnosis.deposit_unmatched: Deposit received but not matched: Trader ID not linked yet (credited after linking)
diagnosis.click_other_user: Click ID belongs to another user — not credited
diagnosis.trader_not_bound: Trader ID not linked — not credited
diagnosis.trader_ambiguous: Trader ID linked in several bots — not credited
diagnosis.registration_unclaimed: Registration without click_id: waits for the user who enters this Trader ID
diagnosis.matched_pending: Deposit waited for the Trader ID link and was credited after it

postback.heldRepeatHint: Same Trader ID and amount within 10 minutes. If it is a separate deposit, press “Count it”.

academy.title: Academy
academy.subtitle: One academy for every bot. Each user has their own progress.
academy.builtInTitle: The starter course is shown now
academy.builtInText: Users see the built-in course ({n} lessons in three languages). Copy it into the database to edit it and add videos and PDFs. User progress is kept.
academy.empty: No categories yet. Create the first one.
academy.bodyHint: A blank line starts a new paragraph. A line starting with "## " is a heading.
academy.videoHint: A YouTube or Vimeo link, or a direct https .mp4 file
academy.videoBad: This link is not supported: use YouTube, Vimeo or an https .mp4
academy.pdfHint: An https link to a PDF (for example a public Google Drive file)
academy.missingLangs: Missing in: {langs}. Users of these languages will see the text in another language.
academy.deleteCategoryHint: A category can be deleted once it has no lessons.

signals.title: Signals
signals.subtitle: One signal system for every bot: pairs, trade durations and limits.
signals.engineNote: No market data or validated analytical model is connected. Signals are issued as training signals: the direction is random, the app says so plainly and promises no profit.
signals.requireFtd: Open the app only after a confirmed FTD
signals.requireFtdHint: On: after the Trader ID check the user waits for a confirmed first deposit of $10 or more. Off: the app opens right after the Trader ID check.
signals.clicklessHint: As in Hidden Dinox Academy: a Pocket Partners registration without our click_id is kept, and the first user who enters that Trader ID links it (one Trader ID — one account across all bots). Turn off to accept only registrations made through the user’s personal link.

userCard.name: Name and username

binding.release: Trader ID moved to another user

userCard.noPermission: Manual actions need the "Manage bindings" permission for this bot.

hint.grant: A separate permission for a technical problem. Deposit, Trader ID and onboarding status stay as they are.
hint.revoke: Removes only the manual permission. If onboarding is completed, access stays.
hint.step_trader_id: The user registered but the app did not move on to step 2.
hint.step_registration: Back to step 1. Registrations and deposits at the partner are not removed.
hint.bind: The Trader ID fails verification because of a technical problem and you have confirmed the account is theirs.
hint.unbind: Back to Trader ID input. Events and deposits are kept.
hint.recheck: Recompute the deposit from partner events already received. Confirms nothing without partner data.

userCard.releaseFromOther: The Trader ID is linked to another user — unlink it there
userCard.reasonPlaceholder: Reason (5+ characters, saved to the audit log)
userCard.confirm: The action runs on the server and is written to the audit log with your name and the reason.

done.step_trader_id: The user is now at Trader ID input.

bot.welcome: Welcome to {name}! Open the app to see market analytics and take the course.
bot.disabled: This bot is temporarily unavailable. Your data is safe — check back later.

onb.registerText: Register with the broker using the button below — the link is personal and tied to your Telegram. Then come back and enter your Trader ID.
onb.linkFallback: Page did not open? Tap here
onb.traderText: The Trader ID is your trading account number at the broker. You will find it in your account profile. Do not confuse it with the UID.
onb.traderHint: We check that the partner confirmed a registration of exactly this Trader ID through your personal link. A correct format alone is not enough.
onb.registerNote: Register only through this button: a registration made through another link cannot be confirmed.

failure.REGISTRATION_NOT_CONFIRMED: The partner has not confirmed a registration with this Trader ID yet. If you have just registered, wait a few minutes. If you did not register through the Register button, register again through it.
failure.CLICK_MISMATCH: This Trader ID was not registered through your personal link, so it cannot be linked. Register a new account with the Register button.
failure.TRADER_ID_TAKEN: This Trader ID is already linked to another Telegram account. If it is your account, contact support.

onb.depositText: Your Trader ID is confirmed. Fund your broker account with at least ${amount} — the app opens as soon as the partner confirms the first deposit.
onb.depositNote: The status updates automatically. Only partner program data counts — amounts, screenshots or messages are not accepted.
onb.noSource: Deposit data is not connected yet. The status changes once the administrator connects the postback.

checkReason.below_threshold: The first deposit is below ${amount}. It does not count as an FTD — contact support.
checkReason.amount_conflict: The partner sent conflicting amount data. Support will check the deposit.
checkReason.no_amount: A deposit arrived without an amount. Support will check it.
checkReason.currency: The deposit is in another currency. Support will check it.
checkReason.no_ftd_event: The partner sent a repeat deposit but no first deposit (FTD). Support will check it.

onb.supportText: Your Trader ID needs a manual check. Contact support — access opens after the check.

app.openInTelegram: The app works only inside Telegram, so we know for sure it is your account.

sig.skip: Don't open, get a new signal
